a-tisket-a-tasket.songSummary: Practices steady beat, finding G by the three black keys, echoing short calls, counting to three and taking turns, with a playground basket rhyme.

classes.title: Tisket, tasket, swing!
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and notice the little call that comes back.
classes.parentTip: Swing your arms like carrying a basket; swing bigger each time 'tisket, tasket' returns.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little call, heard once and then again

classes.parentPrompt: Swing your arms like carrying a basket; swing bigger each time 'tisket, tasket' returns.
classes.childAction: Swing your basket arms and say 'tisket, tasket' with the song.
classes.bridge: Tisket, tasket is the basket swinging: high, low, high, low.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a little call repeat.

classes.title: Walking with the basket
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.
classes.parentTip: Pat your knees slowly together first, then move to the keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Pat your knees slowly together first, then move to the keys.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every step on the way.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one step down the path, basket in hand.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find the basket note G
classes.goal: Find G on the piano by touch, inside the group of three black keys.
classes.parentTip: Touch the three black keys and say 'three!'; then find G after the first.

mathTarget.parentLine: Seeing three black keys at once, without counting one by one

classes.parentPrompt: Touch the three black keys and say 'three!'; then find G after the first.
classes.childAction: Find three black keys, then press G right after the first one.
classes.bridge: Three black keys are a basket handle; G hides just after the first one.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding G by the three black keys.

classes.title: Big basket, little basket
classes.goal: Find G in a second place, higher up, and hop between the two.
classes.parentTip: Say G in a deep voice for the low one, a tiny voice for the high.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same note lives in a low home and a high home

classes.parentPrompt: Say G in a deep voice for the low one, a tiny voice for the high.
classes.childAction: Hop between low G and high G: deep voice, then tiny voice.
classes.bridge: Low G is a big basket on the left; high G is a tiny one.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one note in a low and a high home.

classes.title: Tis-ket echo
classes.goal: Listen to a 2 or 3 note call from the song, then copy it back.
classes.parentTip: Sing 'tis-ket' high-low, then hold your hands in your lap while your child answers.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding two or three sounds in mind, then playing them back

classes.parentPrompt: Sing 'tis-ket' high-low, then hold your hands in your lap while your child answers.
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same.
classes.bridge: G is high, E is a little step lower: tis is up, ket is down.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying short calls.

classes.title: A peeks up, comes back
classes.goal: Echo a short call that steps up to A and comes straight back.
classes.parentTip: Pop your head up on A, back down on G, then play it together.

mathTarget.parentLine: One step up, then the same step back down

classes.parentPrompt: Pop your head up on A, back down on G, then play it together.
classes.childAction: Play G, peek up to A, come back to G.
classes.bridge: A is G's next-door neighbour on the right: one step out, one step home.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a step up and the same step back.

classes.title: Wait for your G
classes.goal: Wait and play G at the right moments while the grown-up plays the rest.
classes.parentTip: Play the blue keys; nod to your child just before each coral G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your turn, then playing exactly then

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys; nod to your child just before each coral G.
classes.childAction: Hands in your lap, then play G when it lights up.
classes.bridge: G is your basket: you pick it up only when the song calls you.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing G.

classes.title: Green G, yellow A
classes.goal: Listen and play the right one of two notes, G or A, in the song.
classes.parentTip: Touch G and say 'green', touch A and say 'yellow', then play.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing which of two sounds it is, then choosing its key

classes.parentPrompt: Touch G and say 'green', touch A and say 'yellow', then play.
classes.childAction: Play G or A, whichever key lights up.
classes.bridge: Like the green and yellow basket: G and A sit side by side.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling G and A apart.

classes.title: Two friends, one basket
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, each with your own notes, on a shared beat.
classes.parentTip: Nod the beat before you start; keep playing even if a note is missed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Nod the beat before you start; keep playing even if a note is missed.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Two hands carry one basket: we walk the song in step.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing together on one shared beat.

classes.title: Oops, dropped it! Concert
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and hear the last note drop down low.
classes.parentTip: Sit teddy facing the piano; on the last low note, say 'oops!' and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song has a start, a middle and an end

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy facing the piano; on the last low note, say 'oops!' and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, say 'oops!' on the last note, then bow.
classes.bridge: On 'dropped it' the tune falls down to C, like the letter falling.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.

all-the-pretty-little-horses.songSummary: Practices a calm slow beat, finding E, echoing short patterns, up and down, counting to three and playing softly together, with a gentle old lullaby.

classes.title: Listen for the horses
classes.goal: Rock to the lullaby and notice each time the horses line comes back.
classes.parentTip: Rock your child slowly; give a gentle knee trot each time 'pretty little horses' comes.

mathTarget.parentLine: One line comes back again and again; we wait for it

classes.parentPrompt: Rock your child slowly; give a gentle knee trot each time 'pretty little horses' comes.
classes.childAction: Rock slowly, and trot on the horses line.
classes.bridge: The horses line is a pony coming back to say goodnight.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for a line that comes back.

classes.title: Slow sleepy hoofbeats
classes.goal: Tap one slow, steady tap for every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.
classes.parentTip: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap slowly together, then gently let go.

mathTarget.parentLine: Even taps, spaced out slowly, like a pony walking

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap slowly together, then gently let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each slow hoofbeat.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one slow hoof stepping, clip... clop... clip... clop.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping a slow, steady beat.

classes.title: Find E, the pony's key
classes.goal: Find the special note E by using the two black keys as a landmark.
classes.parentTip: Guide your child's finger over two black keys, then slide right to E.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finding a place by what sits next to it

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger over two black keys, then slide right to E.
classes.childAction: Touch the two black keys, slide right, and press E gently.
classes.bridge: E is the pony's stable, just right of the two black keys.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E next to the two black keys.

classes.title: Hush-a-bye echo
classes.goal: Hold three notes in mind, then copy them back on the keys.
classes.parentTip: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait for your child's answer.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping three sounds in mind, in order

classes.parentPrompt: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait for your child's answer.
classes.childAction: Listen to hush-a-bye, then play the same three notes.
classes.bridge: Hush-a-bye and don't you cry use the same three notes, A, G, E.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying three notes.

classes.title: Wake up, go to sleep
classes.goal: Echo three notes climbing up to wake, then three walking down to sleep.
classes.parentTip: Stretch up tall for the steps up; curl up small for the steps down.

mathTarget.parentLine: From C, three notes go up, then three go down

classes.parentPrompt: Stretch up tall for the steps up; curl up small for the steps down.
classes.childAction: Climb up to wake, walk down to sleep.
classes.bridge: Steps to the right wake the pony; steps to the left tuck it in.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern going up and coming down.

classes.title: Three Es for dapples
classes.goal: Wait and listen, then play E at its moments, counting the Es in 'dapples'.
classes.parentTip: Play your notes; hold up one, two, three fingers as your child plays each E.

mathTarget.parentLine: Dapples and grays has three Es: one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes; hold up one, two, three fingers as your child plays each E.
classes.childAction: Wait for your turn, then play E: one, two, three!
classes.bridge: Three Es are three ponies in the field: one, two, three.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting your turn and counting three.

classes.title: Ponies side by side
classes.goal: Play the whole lullaby together, sharing one slow, gentle beat.
classes.parentTip: Play slowly and softly; if your child misses an E, keep going and smile.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping one slow beat together

classes.parentPrompt: Play slowly and softly; if your child misses an E, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Play your E notes softly while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: Two ponies walk side by side, step by step, at the same slow speed.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one slow song together.

classes.title: Goodnight concert
classes.goal: Play the whole lullaby for teddy and end it softly, low on A.
classes.parentTip: Sit teddy as the audience; play softly, then whisper goodnight and bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song walks down and rests on a low A

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play softly, then whisper goodnight and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play your notes softly, then take a slow, quiet bow.
classes.bridge: The last notes walk down to low A, like a pony lying down.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song and ending softly.

all-through-the-night.songSummary: Practices a new hand position, the rocking shape of a tune, A-A-B-A song shape and soft calm playing, using an old Welsh lullaby.

classes.title: A new bed for the hand
classes.goal: Hear the lullaby, then find G by the three black keys and place five fingers.
classes.parentTip: Find the three black keys left of middle C; help the thumb rest on G inside them.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the three black keys as a sign to find G

classes.parentPrompt: Find the three black keys left of middle C; help the thumb rest on G inside them.
classes.childAction: Thumb on G, then one finger on each key up to D.
classes.bridge: G tucks in after the first of three black keys, like a child in bed.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding G and placing five fingers.

classes.title: Rock the cradle
classes.goal: Learn the first line and feel the tune rock down and up like a cradle.
classes.parentTip: Rock your child gently left and right as the tune goes down and up.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune goes down, up, then down, like a gentle wave

classes.parentPrompt: Rock your child gently left and right as the tune goes down and up.
classes.childAction: Play C, B, A, then back up to C: rock the cradle.
classes.bridge: Sleep, my child: the notes rock down to the left, then back up.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following a tune that goes down and up.

classes.title: Nearly asleep, then asleep
classes.goal: Learn the next lines and hear one end on B, still awake, and one end on C.
classes.parentTip: Open your eyes wide on the B ending; close them sleepily on the C ending.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same line comes back, but the ending changes

classes.parentPrompt: Open your eyes wide on the B ending; close them sleepily on the C ending.
classes.childAction: Eyes open on the B ending, eyes closed on C.
classes.bridge: B is a yawn, nearly asleep; C is home, fast asleep.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a line that ends in a new way.

classes.title: Up to the moon and back
classes.goal: Hear the middle part float higher, then play the sleepy line when it returns.
classes.parentTip: You play the high middle part; nod when the sleepy line comes back for your child.

mathTarget.parentLine: The middle part moves to the right, where sounds are higher

classes.parentPrompt: You play the high middle part; nod when the sleepy line comes back for your child.
classes.childAction: Point up for the high part, then play your sleepy line.
classes.bridge: The middle floats up to the moon on the right, then drifts back down.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a part that moves higher, then returns.

classes.title: Same, same, new, same
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and find its shape: same, same, new, same.
classes.parentTip: Hold up one hand for each sleepy line and wave both hands for the new high part.

mathTarget.parentLine: A line, the same line, a new part, then the line again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one hand for each sleepy line and wave both hands for the new high part.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; say 'same' or 'new' after each part.
classes.bridge: Sleepy, sleepy, moon, sleepy: the song makes a shape you can say.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the same-same-new-same song shape.

classes.title: Long yawn, short sigh
classes.goal: Practise 'Sleep, my' slowly: one long note, then one short note.
classes.parentTip: Say 'yaaawn-sigh' with the notes; clap it once together before your child plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: One note lasts three times longer than the next

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'yaaawn-sigh' with the notes; clap it once together before your child plays.
classes.childAction: Hold C long like a yawn, then a quick B like a sigh.
classes.bridge: Sleeeep-my: a long stretch on C, then a little hop down to B.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: long notes and short notes.

classes.title: Soft as a blanket
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, softly and smoothly, like a quiet lullaby.
classes.parentTip: Whisper the words and breathe slowly together; pat a slow beat on your child's back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing softly and smoothly, one note melting into the next

classes.parentPrompt: Whisper the words and breathe slowly together; pat a slow beat on your child's back.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and softly, like tucking in a blanket.
classes.bridge: Soft fingers are a warm blanket; each note melts into the next.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly, softly and smoothly.

classes.title: Lullaby play-along
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.
classes.parentTip: Sing softly beside your child; you play the high middle part if needed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping the same calm, slow beat as the music

classes.parentPrompt: Sing softly beside your child; you play the high middle part if needed.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep going after a slip.
classes.bridge: You and the music breathe together: slow, slow, all through the night.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping a calm beat with the music.

classes.title: Lullaby for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole lullaby for teddy, softer and softer, until teddy falls asleep.
classes.parentTip: Lay teddy down as the audience; play together, then whisper 'goodnight' and bow quietly.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song can end by getting quieter and resting at home

classes.parentPrompt: Lay teddy down as the audience; play together, then whisper 'goodnight' and bow quietly.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, softer at the end, then whisper goodnight.
classes.bridge: The last long C is the pillow: the song lies down to sleep.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song softly to the end.

alouette.songSummary: Practices three-finger mirror patterns, same and different lines, walking and running notes, and playing in two places, with a French-Canadian lark song.

classes.title: Find the lark's nest
classes.goal: Find C by its landmark and rest three fingers on C, D and E.
classes.parentTip: Point to the two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C, just left.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C, just left.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, then fingers 2 and 3 on D and E.
classes.bridge: The two black keys are a branch; your three fingers are the lark's nest below.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place by a landmark.

classes.title: Up the branch, back down
classes.goal: Play 'Alouette' slowly: fingers walk up C, D, E, then back down.
classes.parentTip: Walk two fingers up your child's arm on the way up, then back down.

mathTarget.parentLine: Going up, then the same way back down

classes.parentPrompt: Walk two fingers up your child's arm on the way up, then back down.
classes.childAction: Play 1, 2, 3 up, then 3, 2, 1 back down.
classes.bridge: The lark hops up the branch, key by key, then hops back the same way.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern that goes up and mirrors back.

classes.title: Same start, new ending
classes.goal: Hear that the two lines start the same and end in different places.
classes.parentTip: After each line, ask: did it land home on C? You play the low G that flies away.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines that match until the very end

classes.parentPrompt: After each line, ask: did it land home on C? You play the low G that flies away.
classes.childAction: Play the line, then listen: does it end on home C?
classes.bridge: One line flies away to low G on the left; the other lands home on C.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing which lines are the same and different.

classes.title: Your notes, my low G
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly; the child plays C, D, E and the grown-up adds each low G.
classes.parentTip: Play the low G each time it comes; sing the next word if your child gets stuck.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two jobs fit together to make one tune

classes.parentPrompt: Play the low G each time it comes; sing the next word if your child gets stuck.
classes.childAction: Play your C, D, E notes; let your grown-up add the low G.
classes.bridge: Your hand is the lark's nest; the low G is the grown-up's branch to the left.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: fitting two parts together in one song.

classes.title: Run-ning, walk, walk
classes.goal: Play the quick notes slowly: two quick notes for each walking beat.
classes.parentTip: Say 'run-ning' for the quick pairs and 'walk' for the slow notes while your child plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: Quick notes come two for every one walking step

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'run-ning' for the quick pairs and 'walk' for the slow notes while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play the quick pairs as run-ning, the slow notes as walk.
classes.bridge: A walking note is one big step; run-ning is two tiny bird hops.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: fitting two quick notes into one beat.

classes.title: Four beats, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly while counting four beats in every bar.
classes.parentTip: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat and count 1, 2, 3, 4. You play the low G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar holds four even beats

classes.parentPrompt: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat and count 1, 2, 3, 4. You play the low G.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while your grown-up counts to four.
classes.bridge: Each bar is a branch with four perches: one, two, three, four.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly and evenly in fours.

classes.title: The lark flies up high
classes.goal: Play the same song with the same fingers on a higher C.
classes.parentTip: Show your child the next two black keys to the right; help the thumb find that C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same pattern moved to a new place sounds higher

classes.parentPrompt: Show your child the next two black keys to the right; help the thumb find that C.
classes.childAction: Move your hand up to the next C and play the song again.
classes.bridge: Higher C is the same nest, up in the sky: same fingers, brighter song.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same song in a new place.

classes.title: Fly with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.
classes.parentTip: Nod on each beat and play the low G; if a note slips, keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Nod on each beat and play the low G; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The lark keeps flying; fly along with it, even past a bump.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Sing with the lark
classes.goal: Sing the words while playing the tune, one sound for each key.
classes.parentTip: Sing the first line slowly on your own, then sing along while your child plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each sung sound matches one key press

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the first line slowly on your own, then sing along while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Sing the words and play one key for each sound.
classes.bridge: A-lou-et-te has four sounds; your fingers play C, D, E, E.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: singing and playing at the same time.

classes.title: Lark concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy in a gentle, smooth voice, then bow.
classes.parentTip: Sit teddy as the audience; announce the song, play gently, then clap and bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same notes in a soft, smooth way

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; announce the song, play gently, then clap and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play gently for teddy, like a bird singing, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Play like a little lark singing in the sky: soft, smooth and light.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song gently, start to end.

alphabet-song.songSummary: Practices steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, slow and speedy, and playing together, while singing the ABCs.

classes.title: Sway and sing the ABCs
classes.goal: Feel the steady beat of the ABC song with the whole body.
classes.parentTip: Hold your child on your lap, sway on every beat and sing the letters softly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling something that comes again and again, evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Hold your child on your lap, sway on every beat and sing the letters softly.
classes.childAction: Sway, clap and pat your knees while we sing.
classes.bridge: This is the Twinkle tune; the letters ride on it like a boat.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the steady beat, together.

classes.title: Tap the ABC beat
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap for every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.
classes.parentTip: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each beat. Any key is right.
classes.bridge: Each beat is a stepping stone; one tap lands on each stone.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.
classes.parentTip: Crouch and growl for the bear; stretch up tall and chirp for the bird.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch and growl for the bear; stretch up tall and chirp for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a heavy bear on the left; high notes are a tiny bird.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Big ABC, tiny ABC
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.
classes.parentTip: Sing the letters big with strong arms; then whisper them and tiptoe your fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the letters big with strong arms; then whisper them and tiptoe your fingers.
classes.childAction: Loud: big strong taps. Soft: tiny whisper taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are a giant singing ABC; soft taps are a mouse whispering it.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle ABC, bunny ABC
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.
classes.parentTip: Walk your fingers up your child's arm, slowly then quickly, matching the music.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same letters, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's arm, slowly then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are turtle steps; L-M-N-O-P is a quick bunny hop.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: A B C... freeze!
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.
classes.parentTip: Freeze with a funny face when the music stops; cheer when it starts again.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with a funny face when the music stops; cheer when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while music plays. Freeze like a statue when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the letters march; music off, every letter holds still.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Guess the ABC game
classes.goal: Listen and switch between games: high and low, loud and soft, fast and slow.
classes.parentTip: Pause before each picture and ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Then cheer.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Pause before each picture and ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Then cheer.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then tap high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound wears a costume: bear, bird, giant, mouse, turtle or bunny.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: ABC duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.
classes.parentTip: Play the tune and sing the letters; if your child stops, keep playing and smile.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and sing the letters; if your child stops, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays the tune.
classes.bridge: The tune carries the letters; your beat is the road they walk on.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: ABC concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from A all the way to Z, then bow together.
classes.parentTip: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The song is a long walk: start at A, end at Z with a bow.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.

angels-we-have-heard-on-high.songSummary: Practices the five-finger map, walk and run-ning rhythms, echo form, wave patterns, low left-hand notes and loud-soft echoes, with an old French carol.

classes.title: Five keys, five fingers
classes.goal: Find the hand position and learn the first half
classes.parentTip: Say a finger number; your child wiggles that finger, then presses its key.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finger numbers match key places: 1 on C, 5 on G

classes.parentPrompt: Say a finger number; your child wiggles that finger, then presses its key.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C. When you hear a number, press that finger's key.
classes.bridge: Five keys are five shepherds in a row; each finger looks after one.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: matching finger numbers to keys.

classes.title: Walk, walk, run-ning Gloria
classes.goal: Learn the Gloria and feel walking notes change into run-ning notes.

classes.title: The mountains reply
classes.goal: Play the whole carol slowly and hear the verse lines echo each other.
classes.parentTip: Cup your hands like a mountain echo when the first music comes back.

classes.title: Three low notes: C, F, G
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar and hear it change.
classes.parentTip: Play the tune; say the low note's name, C, F or G, just before each bar.

classes.parentTip: Tap a slightly faster beat on your knee; if notes fall apart, go back to slow.

classes.childAction: Play both hands a bit faster. Too fast? Slow down, no problem.

classes.goal: Play the whole carol along with the music at full speed and keep going.
classes.parentTip: Sing 'Gloria' beside your child; if notes are missed, keep going and smile.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Sing 'Gloria' beside your child; if notes are missed, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep singing!

lucy-locket.songSummary: Practices high and low, finding a special note, echoing short patterns and taking turns, with an old three-note playground rhyme.

classes.title: Head, shoulders, tummy
classes.goal: Show the song's three notes with the body: A on the head, G on the shoulders, E on the tummy.
classes.parentTip: Pat your head, shoulders and tummy with the tune; let your child copy you.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three sounds, three places: high, middle, low

classes.parentPrompt: Pat your head, shoulders and tummy with the tune; let your child copy you.
classes.childAction: Pat your head, shoulders or tummy to show each sound.
classes.bridge: The middle note is your shoulders, one up is your head, one down your tummy.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high, middle and low sounds.

classes.title: Lucy walks to the beat
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.
classes.parentTip: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each of Lucy's steps.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one of Lucy's footsteps as she looks for her pocket.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find Lucy's note G
classes.goal: Find G by touch, using the group of three black keys as a landmark.
classes.parentTip: Guide your child's finger to the three black keys, then down between the first two.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the three black keys to find one white key

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to the three black keys, then down between the first two.
classes.childAction: Touch the three black keys, find G, and press it gently.

classes.title: Cuckoo calls
classes.goal: Listen to a short 2 or 3 note call, then play it back the same.
classes.parentTip: Sing or play the call first, then point to your child: your turn.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding a short pattern in mind, then repeating it

classes.parentPrompt: Sing or play the call first, then point to your child: your turn.
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same.
classes.bridge: G down to E is a little cuckoo call: high, then low.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening, remembering and copying short patterns.

classes.title: The pocket in the middle

classes.parentTip: Play G-A-G slowly, then hold up your hands like a mirror and let your child copy.

mathTarget.parentLine: A pattern that is the same from both ends

classes.parentPrompt: Play G-A-G slowly, then hold up your hands like a mirror and let your child copy.
classes.childAction: Play G, up to A, back to G, the same both ways.
classes.bridge: A is the pocket; the two Gs are Lucy's hands holding it on each side.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: copying a pattern that mirrors itself.

classes.title: Wait for Lucy's G
classes.goal: Wait while the grown-up plays, then play G when it is your turn.
classes.parentTip: Play your part, then nod to your child just before each G; smile while they wait.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part, then joining in

classes.parentPrompt: Play your part, then nod to your child just before each G; smile while they wait.
classes.childAction: Wait for the nod, then press G.
classes.bridge: You and your grown-up pass the pocket: they play, you play G.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for a turn, then joining in.

classes.title: G or A? Pick one
classes.goal: Play two special notes, G and A, choosing the right one by listening.
classes.parentTip: Point to G or A before each turn at first, then let your child choose.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound into one of two boxes

classes.parentPrompt: Point to G or A before each turn at first, then let your child choose.
classes.childAction: Listen, choose G or A, and press the right one.
classes.bridge: G is Lucy's pocket; A is the ribbon, one key to the right.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling two sounds apart and choosing one.

classes.title: Lucy and Kitty play
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one steady beat.
classes.parentTip: Play the tune and nod the beat with your head; keep going if your child misses.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep one beat together

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and nod the beat with your head; keep going if your child misses.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Lucy loses the pocket, Kitty finds it: two friends, one song.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, one beat.

classes.title: Pocket concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, end on the last note and bow.
classes.parentTip: Sit teddy as the audience; hold the last note together, then clap and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; hold the last note together, then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, hold the last note, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The song is the pocket's trip: lost, then found with a ribbon round it.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.

mary-had-a-little-lamb.songSummary: Practices steady beat, finding one special note, echoing short patterns, counting to three and taking turns, with a gentle tune about a lamb.

classes.childAction: Sway with the song and shout "again!" when it repeats.

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand and tap together, one tap per beat.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every lamb step.

classes.title: Find the lamb's note E

classes.title: Mama sheep, baby lamb

classes.parentTip: Say "mama" in a deep voice for low E, "baby" in a tiny voice for high E.

classes.title: Baa-baa echo

classes.parentTip: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait for your child's answer.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping a short line of sounds in mind, in order

classes.parentPrompt: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait for your child's answer.
classes.childAction: Listen to the lamb's call, then call it back the same.

classes.title: Down the hill and up

classes.parentTip: Walk your fingers down your child's arm for E-D-C, back up for C-D-E.

mathTarget.parentLine: Going down three steps, then up the same three

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers down your child's arm for E-D-C, back up for C-D-E.
classes.childAction: Walk down the hill, then walk back up the same way.
classes.bridge: E, D, C: the lamb walks down the hill to the left, then back up.

classes.title: Wait for the lamb's E
classes.goal: Wait and listen, then play E at its moments in the song.
classes.parentTip: Play your notes; count one, two, three out loud as your child plays E.

mathTarget.parentLine: Little lamb ends with three Es: one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes; count one, two, three out loud as your child plays E.
classes.childAction: Wait for your turn, then play E: one, two, three!

classes.title: Two notes: D and E
classes.goal: Hear the difference between D and E and play each one when it comes.
classes.parentTip: Point to D or E just before it comes, then let your child press it.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: is it D or is it E?

classes.parentPrompt: Point to D or E just before it comes, then let your child press it.
classes.childAction: Listen, choose D or E, and press the right one.
classes.bridge: D sits between the two black keys; E is next door, on the right.

classes.title: One beat, two players
classes.goal: Play the whole song together and keep one shared beat, even after a miss.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players moving to one even beat

classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.

classes.title: A lamb concert for teddy

mathTarget.parentLine: Every song has a start and a resting end

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; hold the last C long, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, hold the last note, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The last note is low C, home: hold it long like a hug.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.

merrily-we-roll-along.songSummary: Practices finding E, counting groups of three, echoing short patterns and taking turns, using a happy song about friends rolling along together.

classes.childAction: Tap any key on every beat, steady like a wheel.

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes, then look at your child and nod just before each E.
classes.childAction: Wait with your finger ready, then play E when it lights.

michael-row-the-boat.songSummary: Practices keys that skip, counting long notes, hearing a question and its answer, and rowing together, with a traditional spiritual.

classes.parentTip: Say 'run-ning, run-ning, walk, walk' and clap it once before your child plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two running notes take the time of one walking note

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'run-ning, run-ning, walk, walk' and clap it once before your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play the run-ning notes quick, the walk notes slower.
classes.bridge: Yan-kee Doo-dle runs like a pony; dan-dy walks, proud and slow.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: quick notes and walking notes, two to one.

classes.title: Pony hooves, low and steady
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar while the grown-up plays.
classes.parentTip: Say 'clop, two, three, four' aloud; your child plays the low note on every 'clop'.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note, then three waits: clop, two, three, four

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'clop, two, three, four' aloud; your child plays the low note on every 'clop'.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays low C or low G on every 'clop'.
classes.bridge: Low notes on the left are the pony's hooves: clop, two, three, four.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one low note at the start of each bar.

classes.title: Rider and pony, slowly
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand note on each bar, very slowly.
classes.parentTip: Count very slowly and tap your child's left hand at the start of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Both hands share one beat, each with its own job

classes.parentPrompt: Count very slowly and tap your child's left hand at the start of each bar.
classes.childAction: Left hand clops once, right hand plays the tune.
classes.bridge: The left hand is the pony; the right hand is the rider singing.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands with different jobs, slowly.

classes.title: From trot to canter
classes.goal: Play both hands together closer to full speed, keeping the beat even.
classes.parentTip: If the hands tangle, smile and say 'back to a trot'; speed comes last.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same notes and order, only a little quicker

classes.parentPrompt: If the hands tangle, smile and say 'back to a trot'; speed comes last.
classes.childAction: Play both hands a bit faster; slow to a trot if it tangles.
classes.bridge: The pony speeds up from a trot to a canter, hooves still even.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping the beat even at a faster speed.

classes.title: Ride into town
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.
classes.parentTip: March your feet beside your child and sing; if they slip, keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: March your feet beside your child and sing; if they slip, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep riding after a slip.
classes.bridge: The music is the road into town; you ride along without stopping.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: A feather for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy: a gentle verse, then a big proud chorus.
classes.parentTip: Sit teddy as the audience; play the chorus big and proud, then cheer and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing one part softer and the next part louder

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the chorus big and proud, then cheer and bow.
classes.childAction: Play softly for the verse, proudly for the chorus, then bow.
classes.bridge: The verse trots quietly into town; the chorus waves a proud feather.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one part softer, one part louder.
